newsitem.title: USA: The PMI Group issues $100 Million in notes.
newsitem.headline: The PMI Group issues $100 Million in notes.

text.p: The PMI Group Inc said it had issued $100 million worth of 10-year, non-callable notes due November 15, 2006, with an interest rate of 6.75 percent.
It said Goldman, Sachs & Co and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc were the underwriters of the notes, which were issued at par.
The PMI Group, based in San Francisco, is the third largest private mortgage insurer in the United States based on 1995 year-end insurance in force of $71.4 billion.
